result.summary: Base Power's Austin backend role is a promising fit on Python, ownership and energy, but Go, cloud, containers and pay are unverified.

matches.title: Software Engineer, Backend
gaps: Annual pay in your chosen currency is unverified.

criteria.label: Required skills
criteria.reason: Your production Python fits one of the two named languages. Go, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, Terraform and Temporal are not established in your evidence.
criteria.candidateEvidence: Built and maintained production APIs for five years.
criteria.jobEvidence: Write, test, and deploy backend services in Golang and Python

criteria.label: Experience and results
criteria.reason: Your five years of owning services end to end, including on-call, match the posting's ownership scope and its 1–5 year range. You are at the senior end of that range.
criteria.candidateEvidence: Owned services through deployment and incident response.
criteria.jobEvidence: Take responsibility for the features and services you build, from design through production

criteria.label: Direction and learning
criteria.reason: You want to learn reliable distributed systems, and the team's work covers that. Energy is one of your target industries. The posting doesn't describe founder-led decision-making or founder access.
criteria.candidateEvidence: Reliable distributed systems and how a founder-led company makes decisions.
criteria.jobEvidence: distributed commanding systems that orchestrate a growing fleet as a single grid asset

criteria.label: Working environment
criteria.reason: Direct responsibility and feedback match the posting's values. The stated all-in intensity may conflict with your wish for sustainable on-call, and on-call practices aren't described.
criteria.candidateEvidence: Founder-led team with direct responsibility, useful feedback and sustainable on-call practices.
criteria.jobEvidence: It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

requirements.jobEvidence: 1–5 years of professional software development experience
requirements.candidateEvidence: Five years of backend software engineering

requirements.jobEvidence: Proficiency in a backend language (Go, Python, Java, or similar)
requirements.candidateEvidence: Built and maintained production APIs for five years.

requirements.jobEvidence: the ability to write clear, well-tested code
requirements.candidateEvidence: Reduced repeated incidents by adding tests, alerts and runbooks.

requirements.jobEvidence: A working understanding of distributed systems
Some exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

matches.reason: Your Python service ownership, incident response work and Austin location fit this backend role, though you'd need to build up Go and infrastructure skills.
matches.gap: Your evidence doesn't show the required cloud and container exposure (AWS/GCP, Docker/Kubernetes) or Go, the posting's main language. Terraform and IoT/workflow orchestration are only preferred. Pay is also not listed.
matches.nextStep: Before applying, ask Base Power for the annual USD pay range and what on-call looks like. Also prepare a concrete example of a distributed-systems failure you handled in production.
